newsitem.title: UK: UK Nov net bank mortgage lending rises 610 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: UK Nov net bank mortgage lending rises 610 mln stg.

text.p: Net lending for house purchase by major British banks rose a seasonally adjusted 610 million stg in November after a 623 million rise in October, the British Bankers' Association (BBA) said.
Unadjusted gross lending totalled 2.672 billion stg compared with 2.667 billion in October.
The number of new mortgage approvals fell an unadjusted six percent from October to 40,259 and their value was also down six percent at 2.358 billion stg.
BBA director-general Tim Sweeney said the steady recovery seen in major banks' mortgage business continued in November.
"The indications for future growth are promising," he said.

"Unlike a year ago, approvals have held up in November after October's strong figures and together with the building societies data being higher than a year ago, this points to a general and sustainable strengthening of the whole market."
